render_junit_xml_report: render a JUnit XML test report from a resultset to a specified output file path
append_junit_xml_results: append JUnit XML test results as a new testsuite element to an existing XML tree
render_interop_html_report: render an HTML interop test report using a Mako template with client and server language data
create_xml_report_file: create a JUnit XML report file from an ElementTree, ensuring the output directory exists
render_perf_profiling_results: render an HTML unordered list of performance profiling result links to an output file
